title: Iqtisod va biznes lug‘ati
goal_uz: Dars oxirida iqtisodiy atama va hamroh so‘z birikmalarini to‘g‘ri qo‘llab, bozor va tendensiyani aniq fe’l, ravish va predloglar bilan tasvirlaysiz, biznes muhokamasida diplomatik iboralarni ishlatasiz hamda raqam va moliyaviy ko‘rsatkichlarni xatosiz o‘qib, bir daqiqada iqtisodiy tendensiyani tushuntira olasiz.

scenes.title: Iqtisod va biznes tili
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda fan va texnologiya haqida bahslashishni mashq qildik. Bugun pul, bozor va biznes tiliga o‘tamiz. Bu lug‘at yangiliklarni tushunish, ish yig‘ilishida qatnashish va IELTS da grafik tasvirlash uchun zarur. Dars oxirida mamlakatingizdagi biror iqtisodiy tendensiyani bir daqiqa davomida aniq tushuntira olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we debated science and technology. Today: money, markets and business. By the end, you'll explain an economic trend with confidence.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan safar fan va texnologiya haqida bahslashdik. Bugun: pul, bozor va biznes. Oxirida iqtisodiy tendensiyani ishonch bilan tushuntirasiz.

scenes.title: Economy, economic, economical
board: an economic crisis · an economical car

examples.t: The economy is slowing down.
This car is very economical on fuel.

scenes.say_native: Avval bitta so‘z oilasi. Economy bu iqtisodiyot, economics esa universitetda o‘qiladigan iqtisod fani. Economic sifati iqtisodiyotga oid: economic growth, economic policy. Economical esa tejamkor: economical car, kam yoqilg‘i sarflaydigan mashina. Ko‘pchilik economical crisis deydi, bu xato, chunki inqiroz tejamkor bo‘lmaydi. To‘g‘risi economic crisis.
scenes.say: The economy is slowing down. She studied economics at university. We need a new economic policy. And this car is remarkably economical on fuel.
scenes.say_uz: Iqtisodiyot sekinlashmoqda. U universitetda iqtisod o‘qigan. Bizga yangi iqtisodiy siyosat kerak. Bu mashina esa yoqilg‘ini ajoyib tejaydi.

scenes.title: Birinchi nuqta: asosiy atamalar
board: unemployment · interest rates · the budget deficit

examples.t: The country slipped into recession last year.
examples.uz: Mamlakat o‘tgan yili tanazzulga tushib qoldi.

examples.t: GDP grew by three per cent.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi nuqta: iqtisodiy atamalar va hamroh so‘zlar. Inflation narxlarning umumiy o‘sishi, deflation narxlarning tushishi, recession iqtisodiyotning qisqarishi. GDP yalpi ichki mahsulot, ya’ni YaIM. Unemployment ishsizlik, interest rates foiz stavkalari, budget deficit byudjet taqchilligi. Bu so‘zlarni doim fe’li bilan yodlang, chunki inglizchada aynan birikma tabiiy eshitiladi.
scenes.say: The country slipped into recession last year. Unemployment rose, and GDP shrank for two consecutive quarters. Meanwhile, the budget deficit widened.
scenes.say_uz: Mamlakat o‘tgan yili tanazzulga tushdi. Ishsizlik oshdi, YaIM ketma-ket ikki chorak qisqardi. Ayni paytda byudjet taqchilligi kengaydi.

scenes.title: Inflyatsiya va stavkalar bilan birikmalar

examples.t: The central bank raised interest rates to curb inflation.
examples.uz: Markaziy bank inflyatsiyani jilovlash uchun stavkalarni oshirdi.

examples.t: Inflation has eased slightly this month.

scenes.say_native: Inflation bilan qaysi fe’llar ishlatiladi? Inflation rises, soars, ya’ni keskin oshadi, yoki eases, susayadi. Hukumat yoki bank inflyatsiyani curb, tackle yoki bring down qiladi, ya’ni jilovlaydi. Interest rates bilan esa raise, cut va hold: stavkani oshirish, pasaytirish va o‘zgarishsiz qoldirish. Yangiliklarda rates were left on hold degan iborani ko‘p eshitasiz, bu stavka o‘zgarmadi degani.
scenes.say: The central bank raised interest rates to curb inflation. Inflation has eased slightly this month, so rates were left on hold.
scenes.say_uz: Markaziy bank inflyatsiyani jilovlash uchun foiz stavkalarini oshirdi. Bu oy inflyatsiya biroz susaydi, shuning uchun stavkalar o‘zgarishsiz qoldirildi.

scenes.title: O‘zbek va rus tilidan kelgan tuzoqlar
board: kredit olish → take out a loan

examples.t: Our main competitor cut its prices.
She took out a loan to buy a flat.
examples.uz: U kvartira olish uchun kredit oldi.

scenes.say_native: Iqtisodiy so‘zlarning ko‘pi bizga rus tili orqali kirgan, shuning uchun tuzoqlar bor. Konkurent inglizchada competitor, concurrent esa bir vaqtdagi degani. Kredit olish take out a loan. Aksiya Britaniyada odatda shares, Amerikada stocks ham keng ishlatiladi. Milliard o‘rniga billion deymiz. Bu so‘zlarni o‘zbekcha yoki ruscha mantiq bilan tarjima qilmang.
scenes.say: Our main competitor has cut its prices. She took out a loan to buy a flat. He owns shares in several tech companies.
scenes.say_uz: Asosiy raqobatchimiz narxlarini tushirdi. U kvartira sotib olish uchun kredit oldi. Uning bir nechta texnologiya kompaniyalarida aksiyalari bor.

scenes.title: Atamalardagi tipik xatolar
board: ✗ an economical crisis → ✓ an economic crisis
✗ take a credit → ✓ take out a loan
✗ invest money to a start-up → ✓ invest in a start-up
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Birinchisi, economical crisis, to‘g‘risi economic crisis. Ikkinchisi, take a credit: bank qarzini olish take out a loan, credit esa ko‘pincha buy on credit, nasiyaga olish ma’nosida. Uchinchisi, invest to: o‘zbekchadagi ga qo‘shimchasi ta’sirida to qo‘yiladi, to‘g‘risi invest in a start-up. Bu xatolar yozma ishda darrov ko‘zga tashlanadi.
scenes.say: Not an economical crisis, but an economic crisis. Not take a credit, but take out a loan. Not invest to a start-up, but invest in a start-up.
scenes.say_uz: Economical crisis emas, economic crisis. Take a credit emas, take out a loan. Invest to emas, invest in a start-up.

scenes.title: Birikmani to‘ldiring
board: 1) The bank decided to ___ interest rates by half a point.
2) The new policy aims to ___ foreign investment.
3) Many firms went bankrupt during the ___ crisis.
scenes.say_native: Mashq vaqti. Har bir gapda bo‘sh joyga mos so‘zni ayting. Birinchi gapda stavka bilan ishlaydigan fe’l kerak, ikki variant ham bo‘lishi mumkin. Ikkinchi gapda investitsiya bilan keladigan fe’l. Uchinchi gapda economic yoki economical dan birini tanlang. Gapni to‘liq baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Complete the three sentences on the board. Which verbs go with interest rates and with investment? And is it economic or economical?
scenes.say_uz: Doskadagi uchta gapni to‘ldiring. Foiz stavkalari va investitsiya bilan qaysi fe’llar keladi? Economic mi yoki economical?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: raise yoki cut interest rates, ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri, kontekst aniq emas. Increase ham ishlatiladi, lekin yangiliklarda raise va cut eng tabiiy. Ikkinchi: attract foreign investment, encourage ham mos. Uchinchi: the economic crisis, chunki gap iqtisodiyot haqida, tejamkorlik haqida emas. Agar uchalasini to‘g‘ri topgan bo‘lsangiz, birikmalarni yaxshi o‘zlashtiryapsiz.
scenes.say: The bank decided to raise, or cut, interest rates by half a point. The new policy aims to attract foreign investment. Many firms went bankrupt during the economic crisis.
scenes.say_uz: Bank stavkalarni yarim punktga oshirishga yoki pasaytirishga qaror qildi. Yangi siyosat xorijiy investitsiyani jalb qilishni maqsad qiladi. Iqtisodiy inqiroz paytida ko‘p firmalar bankrot bo‘ldi.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi nuqta: tendensiya fe’llari
board: → level off · stabilise · fluctuate · peak · bottom out

examples.t: House prices soared in the capital.
examples.uz: Poytaxtda uy narxlari keskin osmonga chiqdi.

examples.t: Sales levelled off in the second half of the year.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi nuqta: bozor va tendensiyalarni tasvirlash. Ko‘tarilish uchun rise, increase, climb; juda tez va keskin bo‘lsa soar yoki rocket. Pasayish uchun fall, decline, drop; keskin qulash bo‘lsa plummet yoki slump. Barqarorlashish level off yoki stabilise, tebranish fluctuate, eng yuqori nuqta peak, eng past nuqtadan keyin tiklanish bottom out. Bu fe’llar intensivlik darajasi bilan farq qiladi.
scenes.say: House prices soared in the capital, then levelled off. Oil prices fluctuated all year, peaking in March before plummeting in the autumn.
scenes.say_uz: Poytaxtda uy narxlari keskin oshdi, keyin barqarorlashdi. Neft narxlari yil bo‘yi tebrandi, martda eng yuqori nuqtaga chiqdi, kuzda esa keskin qulab tushdi.

scenes.title: Ravish va sifat bilan aniqlik

examples.t: Exports rose sharply in the first quarter.
There was a steady decline in unemployment.

scenes.say_native: Tendensiyaning tezligini ravish bilan beramiz: slightly biroz, moderately o‘rtacha, steadily bir tekis, sharply va dramatically keskin. Har bir gapni ikki usulda ayta olish C1 belgisi. Fe’l va ravish: exports rose sharply. Ot va sifat: there was a sharp rise in exports. Oldingi darslarda ko‘rgan nominalisation shu yerda juda asqotadi, chunki rasmiy hisobotlar aynan ot tuzilmasini yaxshi ko‘radi.
scenes.say: Exports rose sharply. In other words, there was a sharp rise in exports. Unemployment fell steadily: a steady decline.
scenes.say_uz: Eksport keskin oshdi. Boshqacha aytganda, eksportda keskin o‘sish bo‘ldi. Ishsizlik bir tekis kamaydi: barqaror pasayish.

scenes.title: Predloglar: by, to, from, at, in, of
board: a rise in prices · a rise of 5%

examples.t: Unemployment fell from 9% to 7%.
There was a rise of 2% in sales.

scenes.say_native: Predloglar hal qiluvchi. By farqni bildiradi: rose by five per cent, besh foizga oshdi. To yakuniy nuqtani bildiradi: rose to twenty per cent, yigirma foizga yetdi. O‘zbekchada ikkalasi ham ga bilan aytiladi, shuning uchun chalkashlik ko‘p. Stood at ma’lum paytdagi qiymat: unemployment stood at seven per cent. Ot bilan esa a rise in prices, ya’ni nimada, va a rise of five per cent, ya’ni qancha.
scenes.say: Unemployment fell from nine per cent to seven per cent. By December it stood at six per cent. Sales saw a rise of two per cent.
scenes.say_uz: Ishsizlik to‘qqiz foizdan yetti foizga tushdi. Dekabrga kelib olti foizni tashkil etdi. Sotuvlarda ikki foizlik o‘sish bo‘ldi.

scenes.title: Bozorni tasvirlash
board: a saturated market · a niche market · a bull / bear market

examples.t: The smartphone market is now saturated.
Demand for electric cars outstrips supply.

scenes.say_native: Bozorning o‘zini tasvirlash uchun sifatlar: booming gurkirab o‘sayotgan, sluggish sust, volatile beqaror. Saturated market to‘yingan bozor, niche market tor, maxsus bozor. Demand outstrips supply talab taklifdan oshadi. Fond bozorida bull market narxlar ko‘tarilayotgan, bear market esa tushayotgan davr. Bu so‘zlar biznes yangiliklarida doim uchraydi.
scenes.say: The smartphone market is saturated, while demand for electric cars still outstrips supply. Investors remain nervous because the market is highly volatile.
scenes.say_uz: Smartfon bozori to‘yingan, elektromobillarga talab esa hali ham taklifdan oshib ketmoqda. Bozor juda beqaror bo‘lgani uchun investorlar xavotirda.

scenes.title: Tendensiyadagi xatolar
board: ✗ a rise of prices → ✓ a rise in prices
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Birinchisi, raise va rise. Raise o‘timli fe’l, ya’ni kimdir nimanidir ko‘taradi: the bank raised rates. Rise esa o‘zi ko‘tariladi: prices rose. Shakllari ham boshqa: rise, rose, risen. Ikkinchisi, ruschadagi на ta’sirida increased on five per cent deyish, to‘g‘risi increased by. Uchinchisi, a rise of prices emas, a rise in prices. Of dan keyin miqdor keladi.
scenes.say: Not prices raised, but prices rose. The bank raised them. Not increased on five per cent, but increased by five per cent. And not a rise of prices, but a rise in prices.
scenes.say_uz: Prices raised emas, prices rose. Bank ularni raised qildi. Increased on emas, increased by five per cent. A rise of prices emas, a rise in prices.

scenes.title: Grafikni tasvirlang
scenes.say_native: Endi doskadagi ma’lumotlarni tasvirlang. Avtomobil sotuvi, minglab hisobda. Yanvardan aprelgacha, apreldan iyulgacha va iyuldan oktyabrgacha bo‘lgan uch davr uchun bittadan gap tuzing. Mos fe’l, ravish va by, to, from predloglaridan foydalaning. Iyul nuqtasiga alohida e’tibor bering, u qanday nuqta?
scenes.say: Car sales, in thousands. January forty, April forty, July sixty-five, October thirty. Describe each period in one sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Avtomobil sotuvi, minglab. Yanvar qirq, aprel qirq, iyul oltmish besh, oktyabr o‘ttiz. Har bir davrni bitta gap bilan tasvirlang.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: Apr–Jul: they rose sharply to a peak of 65,000.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob. Yanvardan aprelgacha: sales remained stable at forty thousand. Apreldan iyulgacha: they rose sharply to a peak of sixty-five thousand, iyul eng yuqori nuqta. Iyuldan oktyabrgacha: they plummeted to thirty thousand, yoki fell dramatically by thirty-five thousand. To yakuniy son, by esa farq. Fe’llaringiz boshqa bo‘lsa ham, mantiq shu bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Sales remained stable at forty thousand until April. They then rose sharply to a peak of sixty-five thousand in July, before plummeting to thirty thousand in October.
scenes.say_uz: Aprelgacha sotuv qirq ming darajasida barqaror qoldi. Keyin keskin oshib, iyulda oltmish besh minglik cho‘qqiga chiqdi, so‘ng oktyabrda o‘ttiz minggacha qulab tushdi.

scenes.title: Tinglash: choraklik natijalar
board: Sarah: Revenue is up eight per cent.
Tom: But margins have been squeezed.
Sarah: Costs rose by twelve per cent.
scenes.say_native: Endi birinchi dialogni tinglang. Kompaniyaning ikki xodimi, Sarah va Tom, choraklik natijalarni muhokama qilmoqda. Daromad qanchaga oshganiga, foyda ulushi nega qisqarganiga va Tom qanday taklif berganiga e’tibor bering. Dialogdan keyin uchta savolga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Sarah: Revenue is up eight per cent on last quarter, which sounds great. Tom: It does, but our margins have been squeezed. Sarah: Yes, raw material costs rose by twelve per cent. Tom: So we're selling more and earning less. I'd suggest we renegotiate with our suppliers before we even think about raising prices. Sarah: Fair point. Our competitors are holding their prices, so we'd risk losing market share.
scenes.say_uz: Sarah: Tushum o‘tgan chorakka nisbatan sakkiz foiz oshdi, zo‘r eshitiladi. Tom: Ha, lekin foyda ulushimiz qisqardi. Sarah: Ha, xomashyo xarajatlari o‘n ikki foizga oshdi. Tom: Demak ko‘proq sotib, kamroq topyapmiz. Narx oshirishdan oldin yetkazib beruvchilar bilan qayta kelishishni taklif qilaman. Sarah: To‘g‘ri gap. Raqobatchilar narxini ushlab turibdi, bozor ulushini yo‘qotishimiz mumkin.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 3) What does Tom suggest, and why not raise prices?
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha uchta savol. Birinchi: tushum qanchaga oshdi? Ikkinchi: foyda ulushi nega qisqardi? Uchinchi: Tom nimani taklif qiladi va nega hozircha narx oshirish xavfli? Javobni to‘liq inglizcha gap bilan bering va dialogdagi iboralardan foydalanishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: One. How much did revenue rise? Two. Why have margins been squeezed? Three. What does Tom suggest, and why?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Tushum qanchaga oshdi? Ikki. Foyda ulushi nega qisqardi? Uch. Tom nimani taklif qiladi va nega?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) Renegotiate with suppliers; competitors hold prices → lose market share
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: revenue rose by eight per cent on last quarter, ya’ni o‘tgan chorakka nisbatan. Ikkinchi: xomashyo xarajati o‘n ikki foizga oshgani uchun margins have been squeezed, foyda ulushi siqildi. Uchinchi: Tom yetkazib beruvchilar bilan qayta kelishishni taklif qiladi, chunki raqobatchilar narxni oshirmayapti va kompaniya bozor ulushini yo‘qotishi mumkin.
scenes.say: Revenue rose by eight per cent. Margins were squeezed by a twelve per cent rise in costs. Tom suggests renegotiating with suppliers to avoid losing market share.
scenes.say_uz: Tushum sakkiz foizga oshdi. Xarajatlarning o‘n ikki foizlik o‘sishi foyda ulushini siqdi. Tom bozor ulushini yo‘qotmaslik uchun yetkazib beruvchilar bilan qayta kelishishni taklif qiladi.

scenes.title: Uchinchi nuqta: muhokama iboralari
board: Proposing: I'd suggest we… · What if we…? · It might be worth…
Agreeing: Fair point. · That makes sense.
Disagreeing: I see where you're coming from, but…
✗ This plan is wrong. → ✓ I'm not sure this plan would work.

examples.t: What if we postponed the launch until spring?
I see where you're coming from, but the costs are too high.
examples.uz: Fikringizni tushunaman, lekin xarajat juda katta.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi nuqta: biznes muhokamasi iboralari. Taklif uchun I’d suggest we, what if we, it might be worth. What if dan keyin ko‘pincha o‘tgan zamon keladi, bu taklifni yumshatadi: what if we postponed. Rozilik: fair point, that makes sense. O‘zbek tilida hurmatni murojaat shakli bilan beramiz, ingliz biznes tilida esa modal fe’l va yumshatgichlar bilan. Shuning uchun this plan is wrong demaymiz, I see where you’re coming from, but yoki I’m not sure this plan would work deymiz.
scenes.say: What if we postponed the launch until spring? I see where you're coming from, but the costs would be too high. Fair point. Shall we consider a smaller pilot instead?
scenes.say_uz: Ishga tushirishni bahorgacha qoldirsak-chi? Fikringizni tushunaman, lekin xarajat juda katta bo‘lardi. To‘g‘ri gap. Uning o‘rniga kichikroq sinov loyihasini ko‘rib chiqsak-chi?

scenes.title: Yig‘ilishni boshqarish
board: Sorry to interrupt, but could I just add something?
To sum up, we've agreed to…

examples.t: Can we come back to that later?

scenes.say_native: Yig‘ilish iboralari. Boshlash: let’s get down to business, asosiy masalaga o‘taylik. So‘z olish: sorry to interrupt, but could I just add something. Mavzuni keyinga qoldirish: can we come back to that later. Yakunlash: to sum up, we’ve agreed to. Just so‘zi iltimosni yumshatadi, xuddi o‘zbekchadagi bir minutga kabi.
scenes.say: Shall we get down to business? Sorry to interrupt, but could I just add something? To sum up, we've agreed to review the budget next week.
scenes.say_uz: Asosiy masalaga o‘tamizmi? Kechirasiz, bir narsa qo‘shsam maylimi? Xullas, budjetni keyingi hafta qayta ko‘rib chiqishga kelishdik.

scenes.title: Biznes iboralari
board: in the red (−) · in the black (+)
a ballpark figure · the bottom line · cut corners

examples.t: We expect to break even next year.
Can you give me a ballpark figure?

scenes.say_native: Biznesda doim uchraydigan iboralar. Break even, ya’ni na zarar, na foyda: xarajat va daromad teng. In the red zarar bilan ishlash, in the black esa foyda bilan. Bu ibora eski buxgalteriya odatidan kelgan: zarar qizil siyohda yozilgan. Ballpark figure taxminiy raqam. The bottom line eng muhim natija yoki xulosa. Cut corners esa sifatni yo‘qotib, xarajatni tejash, salbiy ma’noli ibora.
scenes.say: We expect to break even next year. Can you give me a ballpark figure? The bottom line is: we can't cut corners on safety.
scenes.say_uz: Kelasi yili zararsiz ishlashni kutyapmiz. Taxminiy raqam ayta olasizmi? Xulosa: xavfsizlikda tejab, sifatni buzolmaymiz.

scenes.title: Muhokamadagi xatolar
board: ✗ I am agree with you → ✓ I agree with you
✗ Let's discuss about the budget → ✓ Let's discuss the budget
✗ make a meeting → ✓ hold / have a meeting
scenes.say_native: Muhokamadagi uchta keng tarqalgan xato. Birinchisi, I am agree. Agree fe’l, unga am kerak emas: I agree yoki I’m in agreement. Ikkinchisi, discuss about. O‘zbekchada nima haqida gaplashamiz deymiz, lekin discuss o‘timli fe’l, darhol to‘ldiruvchi oladi: discuss the budget. Talk about esa to‘g‘ri. Uchinchisi, make a meeting. To‘g‘risi hold, have yoki arrange a meeting.
scenes.say: Not I am agree, but I agree. Not discuss about the budget, but discuss the budget, or talk about the budget. Not make a meeting, but hold a meeting.
scenes.say_uz: I am agree emas, I agree. Discuss about emas, discuss the budget yoki talk about the budget. Make a meeting emas, hold a meeting.

scenes.title: Diplomatik qiling
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Doskada uchta keskin gap bor. Har birini biznes yig‘ilishiga mos, diplomatik qilib qayta ayting. Darsda ko‘rgan I’m not sure, it might be worth, I see where you’re coming from yoki what if kabi iboralardan foydalaning. Ma’no saqlansin, faqat ohang yumshasin.
scenes.say: Make these more diplomatic. One. Your idea is bad. Two. We must cut costs now. Three. That number is wrong.
scenes.say_uz: Bularni diplomatikroq qiling. Bir. G‘oyangiz yomon. Ikki. Hozir xarajatlarni qisqartirishimiz shart. Uch. Bu raqam noto‘g‘ri.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
board: 1) I see where you're coming from, but I'm not sure it would work.
2) It might be worth cutting costs sooner rather than later.
3) I think that figure might need checking.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: I see where you’re coming from, but I’m not sure it would work. Ikkinchi: it might be worth cutting costs sooner rather than later, yoki what if we cut costs now. Uchinchi: I think that figure might need checking. Uchinchi gapda xatoni odamga emas, raqamga yuklaymiz va majhul ma’noli need checking ishlatamiz. Bu usul hech kimni noqulay ahvolga solmaydi.
scenes.say: I see where you're coming from, but I'm not sure it would work. It might be worth cutting costs sooner rather than later. I think that figure might need checking.
scenes.say_uz: Fikringizni tushunaman, lekin ish berishiga ishonchim yo‘q. Xarajatlarni kechiktirmay qisqartirish foydali bo‘lishi mumkin. Menimcha, bu raqamni tekshirib ko‘rish kerak.

scenes.title: To‘rtinchi nuqta: katta sonlar

examples.t: The project cost 2.5 billion dollars.
The company employs 12,000 people.

scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi nuqta: raqamlar va moliya. O‘zbekcha milliard inglizchada billion, trillion esa trillion. Eng muhim farq vergul va nuqtada. O‘zbekchada ikki butun o‘ndan besh 2,5 deb yoziladi, inglizchada 2.5, two point five. Inglizchada vergul minglarni ajratadi: 12,000. Vergulni noto‘g‘ri qo‘ysangiz, raqam ming barobar o‘zgarib ketishi mumkin.
scenes.say: The project cost two point five billion dollars. In English, a point separates decimals, and a comma separates thousands.
scenes.say_uz: Loyiha ikki butun o‘ndan besh milliard dollarga tushdi. Inglizchada nuqta o‘nli kasrni, vergul esa minglarni ajratadi.

scenes.title: Raqamlarni o‘qish
board: 0.25 = nought point two five (BrE) / zero point two five

examples.t: Profits reached £3.75 million.
The rate is 0.25 per cent.

scenes.say_native: Raqamlarni o‘qish qoidalari. Valyuta belgisi oldin yoziladi, lekin oxirida o‘qiladi: four point five million dollars. Nuqtadan keyingi raqamlar alohida o‘qiladi: three point seven five, three point seventy-five emas. Nolni Britaniyada ko‘pincha nought, Amerikada zero deyishadi. Aniq sondan keyin million, billion ko‘plik s olmaydi: five million dollars.
scenes.say: Profits reached three point seven five million pounds. The rate is nought point two five per cent. Revenue hit one point two billion euros.
scenes.say_uz: Foyda uch butun yuzdan yetmish besh million funtga yetdi. Stavka nol butun yuzdan yigirma besh foiz. Tushum bir butun o‘ndan ikki milliard yevroga yetdi.

scenes.title: Per cent va percentage point

examples.t: The interest rate rose by two percentage points.

scenes.say_native: Nozik farq. Stavka to‘rt foizdan olti foizga oshdi deylik. Bu two percentage points, ikki foiz punktiga o‘sish. Lekin nisbiy jihatdan bu fifty per cent, chunki ikki to‘rtning yarmi. Jurnalistlar ham buni ko‘p chalkashtiradi. Britaniyada per cent ikki so‘z, Amerikada percent bitta so‘z bilan yoziladi. Ot sifatida percentage: a large percentage.
scenes.say: If a rate rises from four to six per cent, that is a rise of two percentage points, but an increase of fifty per cent. Keep the two ideas apart.
scenes.say_uz: Agar stavka to‘rtdan olti foizga oshsa, bu ikki foiz punktiga o‘sish, lekin ellik foizlik o‘sish. Bu ikki tushunchani ajrating.

scenes.title: Moliyaviy atamalar

examples.t: Turnover rose, but net profit fell.
examples.uz: Aylanma oshdi, lekin sof foyda kamaydi.

examples.t: The firm has serious cash-flow problems.
examples.uz: Firmada pul oqimi bilan jiddiy muammo bor.

scenes.say_native: Moliyaviy hisobot tili. Revenue yoki Britaniyada ko‘p ishlatiladigan turnover umumiy tushum. Undan costs ayrilsa profit yoki loss qoladi, net profit sof foyda. Profit margin foydaning tushumdagi ulushi. Assets aktivlar, liabilities majburiyatlar. Shareholders aksiyadorlar, ularga dividends to‘lanadi. Cash flow pul oqimi: foyda bo‘lsa ham, pul o‘z vaqtida kelmasa, firma qiynaladi.
scenes.say: Turnover rose last year, but net profit fell because costs grew faster. The firm is profitable on paper, yet it has serious cash-flow problems.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan yili aylanma oshdi, lekin xarajatlar tezroq o‘sgani uchun sof foyda kamaydi. Firma qog‘ozda foydali, ammo pul oqimi bilan jiddiy muammolari bor.

scenes.title: Raqamlardagi xatolar
board: ✗ five millions dollars → ✓ five million dollars
✗ fell twice less → ✓ fell by half / halved
scenes.say_native: Raqamlardagi tipik xatolar. Birinchisi, five millions dollars. Aniq son bilan million, billion, thousand ko‘plik qo‘shimchasini olmaydi. Faqat aniq son bo‘lmaganda ko‘plik: millions of people, millionlab odam. Ikkinchisi, milliard so‘zi: zamonaviy ingliz tilida billion ishlating. Uchinchisi, twice less: bu ruscha mantiqdan kelgan va tabiiy emas. To‘g‘risi fell by half yoki halved.
scenes.say: Not five millions dollars, but five million dollars. But we do say millions of people. Not three milliards, but three billion. And not twice less, but halved, or fell by half.
scenes.say_uz: Five millions dollars emas, five million dollars. Lekin millions of people deymiz. Three milliards emas, three billion. Twice less emas, halved yoki fell by half.

scenes.title: Raqamlarni o‘qing
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Doskadagi raqamlarni baland ovozda o‘qing. Birinchisi valyuta va milliard. Ikkinchisi kichik foiz. Uchinchisida stavka uch foizdan to‘rt yarim foizga oshgan: buni ikki usulda ayting, foiz punktida va foizda. Hisoblashga shoshilmang, o‘ylab ko‘ring.
scenes.say: Read the figures on the board aloud. For number three, a rate rises from three to four point five per cent: describe the change in two ways.
scenes.say_uz: Doskadagi raqamlarni baland ovozda o‘qing. Uchinchisida stavka uch foizdan to‘rt butun o‘ndan besh foizga oshadi: o‘zgarishni ikki usulda tasvirlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) seven point two five billion dollars
2) nought / zero point seven five per cent
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: seven point two five billion dollars, dollar so‘zi oxirida. Ikkinchi: nought point seven five per cent, Amerika uslubida zero point seven five percent. Uchinchi: stavka one point five percentage points ga oshdi, foizda esa fifty per cent ga, chunki bir yarim uchning yarmi. Agar uchinchisini to‘g‘ri hisoblagan bo‘lsangiz, ko‘plab jurnalistlardan aniqroq gapiryapsiz.
scenes.say: Seven point two five billion dollars. Nought point seven five per cent. And the rate rose by one point five percentage points, which is an increase of fifty per cent.
scenes.say_uz: Yetti butun yuzdan yigirma besh milliard dollar. Nol butun yuzdan yetmish besh foiz. Stavka bir yarim foiz punktiga oshdi, bu ellik foizlik o‘sish.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: urg‘u ko‘chishi

examples.t: There was an INcrease in EXports.
We plan to inCREASE our exPORTS.

scenes.say_native: Talaffuz nuqtasi. Economy so‘zida urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: e-CO-no-my. Economic va economics da esa urg‘u NO bo‘g‘iniga ko‘chadi. Ikkinchi qoida: ba’zi so‘zlarda ot va fe’l urg‘u bilan farqlanadi. Ot: an INcrease, an EXport, urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda. Fe’l: to inCREASE, to exPORT, urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda. Decrease ham shunday. Revenue esa doim birinchi bo‘g‘indan: REV-e-nue.
scenes.say: Economy. Economic. Economics. There was an increase in exports. We plan to increase our exports. Revenue.
scenes.say_uz: Iqtisodiyot. Iqtisodiy. Iqtisod fani. Eksportda o‘sish bo‘ldi. Eksportimizni oshirishni rejalashtiryapmiz. Tushum.

scenes.title: Urg‘uni to‘g‘ri qo‘ying
board: 3) We export cotton. Cotton is a key export.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta gapni baland ovozda o‘qing va urg‘uni to‘g‘ri joyga qo‘ying. Avval o‘zingizga savol bering: bu so‘z gapda ot vazifasidami yoki fe’lmi? Uchinchi gapda bitta so‘z ikki marta, ikki xil vazifada keladi. Keyin namunani eshitib, o‘zingizni tekshiring.
scenes.say: Read these with the correct stress. One. The decrease was small. Two. Prices will decrease. Three. We export cotton. Cotton is a key export.
scenes.say_uz: Bularni to‘g‘ri urg‘u bilan o‘qing. Bir. Pasayish kichik edi. Ikki. Narxlar pasayadi. Uch. Biz paxta eksport qilamiz. Paxta asosiy eksport mahsuloti.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi gapda decrease ot, chunki oldida the artikli bor, shuning uchun DE-crease. Ikkinchida will dan keyin fe’l, demak de-CREASE. Uchinchida avval we export, fe’l, ex-PORT; keyin a key export, ot, EX-port. Artikl yoki sifat oldida kelsa, odatda bu ot. Bu qoida present, record, import kabi so‘zlarda ham ishlaydi.
scenes.say: The decrease was small. Prices will decrease. We export cotton. Cotton is a key export.
scenes.say_uz: Pasayish kichik edi. Narxlar pasayadi. Biz paxta eksport qilamiz. Paxta asosiy eksport mahsuloti.

scenes.title: Tinglash: radio intervyu
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Biznes radiosida boshlovchi iqtisodchi bilan suhbatlashmoqda. Inflyatsiya qanchadan qanchaga tushganiga, markaziy bank nima qilganiga va iqtisodchi nima haqida ogohlantirganiga e’tibor bering. Raqamlarni yozib oling, ular savollarda kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Host: Is the worst over? Economist: To some extent. Inflation has eased to around four per cent, down from a peak of nine per cent last year. Host: And interest rates? Economist: The central bank has kept them on hold for now. Host: So what's the main risk? Economist: Consumer spending remains sluggish. If households keep cutting back, growth could stall, so I wouldn't celebrate just yet.
scenes.say_uz: Boshlovchi: Eng og‘ir davr ortda qoldimi? Iqtisodchi: Ma’lum darajada. Inflyatsiya o‘tgan yilgi to‘qqiz foizlik cho‘qqidan taxminan to‘rt foizgacha pasaydi. Boshlovchi: Foiz stavkalari-chi? Iqtisodchi: Markaziy bank hozircha ularni o‘zgartirmadi. Boshlovchi: Asosiy xavf nima? Iqtisodchi: Iste’mol xarajatlari sustligicha qolmoqda. Oilalar tejashda davom etsa, o‘sish to‘xtab qolishi mumkin, shuning uchun hozircha bayram qilishga shoshilmayman.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 1) What was inflation's peak, and where is it now?
2) What has the central bank done?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: inflyatsiyaning eng yuqori nuqtasi qancha edi va hozir qancha? Ikkinchi: markaziy bank stavkalar bilan nima qildi? Uchinchi: iqtisodchi qanday xavfni ko‘radi va nega u hali bayram qilmaydi? Javoblarda dialogdagi fe’llarni ishlatishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: One. Where did inflation peak, and where is it now? Two. What has the central bank done? Three. What is the main risk?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Inflyatsiya qayerda cho‘qqiga chiqdi va hozir qancha? Ikki. Markaziy bank nima qildi? Uch. Asosiy xavf nima?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) Sluggish consumer spending → growth could stall
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: inflyatsiya o‘tgan yili to‘qqiz foizda cho‘qqiga chiqqan, hozir taxminan to‘rt foiz. Ikkinchi: bank stavkalarni o‘zgartirmagan, kept them on hold. Uchinchi: iste’mol xarajatlari sust, oilalar tejashda davom etsa, growth could stall. Iqtisodchi could va wouldn’t orqali ehtiyotkor gapirganiga ham e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Inflation peaked at nine per cent and has eased to around four. Rates are on hold. The main risk is sluggish consumer spending.
scenes.say_uz: Inflyatsiya to‘qqiz foizda cho‘qqiga chiqib, taxminan to‘rt foizgacha pasaydi. Stavkalar o‘zgarmagan. Asosiy xavf sust iste’mol xarajatlari.

scenes.title: Namuna: tendensiyani tushuntirish
board: 1 Context: Over the past few years…
3 Cause: largely owing to… · 4 Effect: As a result…
5 Outlook: …is likely to continue, provided that…

examples.t: The number of foreign visitors has risen considerably.

scenes.say_native: Endi hammasini bir joyga yig‘amiz. Iqtisodiy tendensiyani tushuntirishda besh qadam ishlaydi: kontekst, tendensiya, sabab, oqibat va ehtiyotkor prognoz. Namunada over the past few years kontekst, has risen considerably tendensiya, largely owing to sabab, as a result oqibat, is likely to continue, provided that esa prognoz. E’tibor bering, unda o‘ylab topilgan raqam yo‘q: aniq raqamni bilmasangiz, roughly yoki considerably deng.
scenes.say: Over the past few years, the number of foreign tourists visiting Uzbekistan has risen considerably, largely owing to simplified visa rules. As a result, new hotels and guesthouses have sprung up. This trend is likely to continue, provided that infrastructure keeps pace.
scenes.say_uz: So‘nggi bir necha yilda O‘zbekistonga keladigan xorijiy sayyohlar soni sezilarli oshdi, bunga asosan soddalashtirilgan viza qoidalari sabab bo‘ldi. Natijada yangi mehmonxona va mehmon uylari paydo bo‘ldi. Infratuzilma ham ortda qolmasa, bu tendensiya davom etishi ehtimoli katta.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: bir daqiqalik nutq
board: Choose: prices · jobs · housing · trade · a local industry
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Bitta mavzu tanlang: narxlar, ish o‘rinlari, uy-joy, savdo yoki o‘zingiz biladigan soha. Bir daqiqa davomida beshta qadam bo‘yicha gapiring. Kamida uchta birikma, ikkita tendensiya fe’li va bitta raqam ishlating. Raqamni aniq bilmasangiz, roughly yoki nearly bilan ayting. Tayyorlanishga bir oz vaqt oling, keyin ovoz chiqarib gapiring.
scenes.say: Choose a trend in your country. Speak for one minute. Give the context, the trend, the causes, the effects and a cautious outlook.
scenes.say_uz: Mamlakatingizdagi bir tendensiyani tanlang. Bir daqiqa gapiring. Kontekst, tendensiya, sabablar, oqibatlar va ehtiyotkor prognozni bering.

scenes.title: O‘zingizni tekshiring
board: ✓ by vs to · a rise in
✓ point not comma · million without -s · hedged outlook
scenes.say_native: Endi nutqingizni tekshiring. Economic va economical ni to‘g‘ri ishlatdingizmi? Rise va raise ni aralashtirmadingizmi? By va to predloglari o‘z joyidami? Raqamlarda nuqta va vergul, million so‘zida s yo‘qligi to‘g‘rimi? Prognozni likely, may, could bilan yumshatdingizmi? Agar ikki-uch joyda ikkilansangiz, nutqni yozib oling va qaytadan ayting. Ikkinchi urinish doim sezilarli yaxshi chiqadi.
scenes.say: Check yourself. Did you use economic, not economical? Rose, not raised? By and to correctly? A point, not a comma, in decimals? And did you hedge your outlook?
scenes.say_uz: O‘zingizni tekshiring. Economical emas, economic ishlatdingizmi? Raised emas, rose? By va to to‘g‘rimi? O‘nli kasrda vergul emas, nuqta? Prognozni yumshatdingizmi?

scenes.title: Qisqa takrorlash
board: 1 Terms + collocations: curb inflation, raise rates
2 Trends: verb + adverb, by / to / from
3 Meetings: I'd suggest… · I see where you're coming from…
scenes.say_native: Takrorlaymiz. Birinchi: atamalarni fe’li bilan o‘rganing, curb inflation, raise rates, attract investment, va economic bilan economical ni farqlang. Ikkinchi: tendensiyani aniq tasvirlang, by farq, to yakuniy nuqta. Uchinchi: muhokamada diplomatik iboralar. To‘rtinchi: o‘nli kasrda nuqta, milliard o‘rniga billion, foiz va foiz punkti farqi.
scenes.say: To recap: learn terms with their verbs, describe trends precisely, disagree diplomatically, and read numbers the English way.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: atamalarni fe’llari bilan o‘rganing, tendensiyani aniq tasvirlang, diplomatik e’tiroz bildiring va raqamlarni inglizcha o‘qing.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: explain an economic trend in your country
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: mamlakatingizdagi bitta iqtisodiy tendensiyani bir yuz ellik, ikki yuz so‘zda yozing yoki ikki daqiqalik audio yozib oling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: beshta qadam bor, kamida beshta birikma, uchta tendensiya fe’li va ikkita to‘g‘ri raqam ishlatilgan, raqamlar ishonchli manbadan. Keyingi darsda taqdimot qilish san’atini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: For homework, explain an economic trend in your country, in writing or in a short recording. Next time, we will look at the art of giving presentations.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: mamlakatingizdagi iqtisodiy tendensiyani yozma yoki qisqa audio orqali tushuntiring. Keyingi safar taqdimot qilish san’atini ko‘rib chiqamiz.

homework_uz: Mamlakatingizdagi bitta iqtisodiy tendensiyani (narxlar, ish o‘rinlari, uy-joy, savdo yoki biror soha) 150–200 so‘zda yozing yoki 2 daqiqalik audio yozib oling. Mezon: kontekst, tendensiya, sabablar, oqibatlar va ehtiyotkor prognoz bor; kamida 5 ta birikma, 3 ta tendensiya fe’li va 2 ta to‘g‘ri yozilgan yoki o‘qilgan raqam ishlatilgan; raqamlar ishonchli manbadan olingan.

quiz.why_uz: Economic iqtisodiyotga oid, economical esa tejamkor degani.
Rise o‘zi ko‘tariladi (rise–rose–risen); raise o‘timli fe’l.
Boshlang‘ich nuqta from, yakuniy nuqta to bilan.
Nimada o‘sish: a rise in; qancha o‘sish: a rise of 5%.

quiz.q: How do you write 'ikki butun o‘ndan besh milliard dollar' in English?
quiz.why_uz: Inglizchada o‘nli kasrda nuqta, milliard o‘rniga billion, s qo‘shilmaydi.

quiz.q: A rate rises from 4% to 6%. This is a rise of…
quiz.why_uz: Farq 2 foiz punkti; nisbiy o‘sish esa 50 foiz.

quiz.q: Which is the most diplomatic way to disagree?
options: I see where you're coming from, but…
quiz.why_uz: Ingliz biznes tilida e’tiroz yumshatgich bilan bildiriladi.
Discuss o‘timli fe’l, about kerak emas.

options: make neither a profit nor a loss
quiz.why_uz: Break even xarajat va daromad teng, zarar ham, foyda ham yo‘q.

quiz.q: Where is the stress in the verb 'to increase'?
quiz.why_uz: Fe’lda urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda, otda (an INcrease) birinchi bo‘g‘inda.
